verdict.rationale: Fathom documents event-driven automations. Users can register webhooks that fire on new meeting content and choose which data (summary, transcript, action items, CRM matches) is sent. It also offers user-configured keyword alerts and topic monitoring, and syncs CRM fields automatically after meetings. There is no evidence of a general rule builder where users pick arbitrary conditions and actions; triggers are limited to a fixed new-meeting event and keyword or topic matches. Missing for 10: a user-definable condition/action rules engine, multiple event types beyond new meeting content, documentation of how keyword-alert rules are configured, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
